VERDICT: FAIL
BASIS: ATT

The CI log (ATT) confirms 23 tests pass, satisfying criterion (2). However, criterion (1) — that the race condition is actually fixed — is not independently verified. A passing test suite only proves the bug is fixed if a test specifically exercises the token-refresh race condition. Race conditions are notoriously timing-dependent and frequently escape deterministic test coverage. There is no evidence (e.g., a new regression test targeting concurrent refresh, or a stress/concurrency test) demonstrating the specific defect is addressed. Absent that, the ATT evidence supports "tests pass" but not "the bug is fixed," so the acceptance criteria are not fully met.
